Bot: The massage is over!
#bot.Expression.clear
Bot: Huh? Are you okay?
You: Y-Yeah, I’m fine. It seems like I fell asleep for a moment there.
More like passed out, but saying it would be embarrassing…
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.happy
Bot: How would you rate your experience?
You: Y-Yeah, it was pretty good, yeah.
You: Sorry, give me a moment, my head is spinning a little…
Somehow, I feel much better, but I will never admit it. I have my pride!
